purpose: Teach: ハンサム/ニコチン/馬力/ハイウェイ/アスファルト/鰻/怪談/ニンジン

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんはハンサムでいらしたぞ
lines.en: Your father was quite the handsome one in his day, Gran.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic opening. Voice settles into a gentle memory. Even pace, slightly distant—looking back rather than at her. Warm but untethered to the present.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、ニコチン中毒に苦しまれた時期もあったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and you certainly had your struggles with cigarettes back then, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Gentle, knowing tease underneath. Not unkind—affectionate correction wrapped in tenderness. Light, almost musical lilt on 'dear.' She's calling him out with love.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが馬力の強い車を運転されたぞ
lines.en: Your father drove quite a powerful car in those days, Gran.
lines.style: Same wistful register as before. Quiet admiration in the voice. Steady, deliberate pacing. He's painting a picture for her, for himself.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ハイウェイを使って旅をされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and you took those long highway trips, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Lighter, almost playful now. She's meeting him in the memory but gently redirecting—including herself in the story. Warm chuckle underneath. Affectionate.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、アスファルト舗装が珍しかったぞ
lines.en: Asphalt roads were quite rare when we were young, Gran.
lines.style: Thoughtful, reaching back. Voice carries the weight of time—how different things were. Slow, measured delivery. Almost philosophical.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、土用の鰻をお召し上がりになるのが楽しみでらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and you always looked forward to unagi during Doyo season, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm, indulgent. She's following his drift but anchoring him in something real—food, ritual, pleasure. Gentle and grounded. A smile in her voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが孫に怪談話を聞かせたぞ
lines.en: Your father used to tell the grandchildren ghost stories, Gran.
lines.style: Quieter now, more intimate. Voice softens with the memory—something tender beneath the wistfulness. Slight lean forward, as if sharing something precious.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ニンジンを煮物にされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and you made that wonderful carrot stew, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Warmth closing in. Voice gentle and complete now—she's brought him fully home. Soft fadeout on 'dear.' She knows him entirely.
